author: architect (Claude Opus 5.5, Medium), user-approved 2026-11-05
trigger: Engineer specification stop (phase2-readiness handover 145, 2026-11-05T11:51Z): gate 7 needs a full-scoring forecast for every judged candidate, but the protocol does not name the full forecast of each arm and the blend addendum defines only blend_core_xp.
amends_nothing: The frozen protocol, frozen models, blend addendum, execution addendum, candidates, window, thresholds and decision rule are unchanged. This record only names the forecast that enters gate 7 for each arm.

gate7_full_forecast.control: the frozen control's core prediction (it has no defensive-contribution head), as in the fplcache study (PR68)
gate7_full_forecast.conditional: the frozen conditional model's expected_points = core_xp + dc_xp, as in the fplcache study (PR68)
gate7_full_forecast.blend_equal: 0.5 * control full forecast + 0.5 * conditional expected_points, per fixture row; that is, the same equal weight applied to each arm's own gate 7 forecast
gate7_full_forecast.statistic: RMSE over player-gameweek sums (fixture values summed per season, gameweek and player) on the phase 2 window, as in the fplcache study

rule: Every gate input for blend_equal is the equal-weight average of the two frozen models' inputs for that same gate. Gates 2-4 and 6 already use core forecasts (blend_core_xp); gate 7 uses each arm's full forecast.
information_used: No blend full-scoring value has been computed on any data. The fplcache study (PR68) reported full-scoring RMSE for control and conditional only, on 2022/23-2024/25, before this record; no 2026/27 data has been read.
timing_rule: Intended to be first pushed before the GW10 deadline. If the first push is later, the rule still applies and the phase 2 report must state the push time.
not_authorised: any 2026/27 prediction, outcome or availability read before the phase 2 package
